author: GameTrailers
description:
Storyteller lets you build stories using drag and drop. The goal on each level is to make a story that fits the given title by placing settings and characters that react to each other, creating a narrative through their relationships. 

Check out the trailer for the free Storyteller: Special Edition update, which brings new chapters and new levels added to existing classic chapters, as well as updates to the navigation through the storybook, the achievement stamp system, and the tutorial. In the free Special Edition update on Steam, experiment with Dr. Frankenstein and his monster, sail the seas with pirates, venture into the woods with Hansel and Gretel and slay a (real) dragon. 

Storyteller: Special Edition is available on Steam and mobile (via Netflix Games).
title: Storyteller: Special Edition - Official Steam Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Moonlight Peaks is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5). Enter the magical world of Moonlight Peaks in this PS5 launch trailer for the supernatural (un-)life sim. The PS5 version features all of the latest updates to other platforms, including optimizations and quality-of-life improvements.

Experience life as a vampire in a magical town full of werewolves, witches, mermaids, and more in Moonlight Peaks. Set out to show their skeptical father that a life of compassion is possible – even for the undead. Make friends with the other local creatures of the night and perhaps find eternal love in the mystical dating scene.

Players will settle down in the family’s haunted cottage, customizing it to suit their own sense of gothic style. Embrace immortality and unlock ancient abilities, master potion brewing, and expand a grimoire of spells, all in the name of a more bountiful harvest. Unravel the mysteries of the seven families that inhabit Moonlight Peaks and bring a bit of light back to th
title: Moonlight Peaks - Official PlayStation 5 (PS5) Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Get a deep dive into the gameplay, the new Class Trial system, Slayhem mode, and more from Danganronpa 2x2 in this latest trailer for the upcoming visual novel remake. Danganronpa 2x2 will be available on PC, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) on January 14, 2027.

Danganronpa 2x2 includes a brand-new scenario based on Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair. The setting and cast of characters remain the same, but a certain incident triggers a completely different chain of events with different victims, culprits, and tricks. 

The original scenario of Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair has been updated with new visuals and production value for modern game systems. Players will experience the shocking story, revamped to deliver a more beautiful and satisfying gameplay experience.
title: Danganronpa 2x2 - Official Overview Trailer

description:
Update 1.2 for The Blood of Dawnwalker is available now on PC, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S. Watch the latest trailer for The Blood of Dawnwalker to see what to expect from Update 1.2, which brings New Game+ to the dark fantasy action RPG. 

New Game+ can be unlocked after completing the epilogue. Level, skills, and items are carried over. Other features include updated item progression, uniform level scaling across all regions, and the level cap raised to 100.

description:
Grindworm gets a chaotic new trailer and a release date. Check out the latest Grindworm trailer for this upcoming horror game. Grindworm will be available on Steam on January 18, 2027.

Grindworm is a horror game built around isolation, dread, and the slow erosion of reality. You were late for your shift. Now the tunnels have collapsed, your crew is missing, and your only hope is a worn-out mining machine. Workplace safety rules no longer apply. Just remember: Don't. Stop. Digging.
